name: madchef
description: MadChef — find recipes from the ingredients you already have. MERN stack (React + TypeScript + Vite, GraphQL/Apollo, Express, MongoDB).

scripts.install: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client

author: Nicholas Clarke
